title: Morena’s Elections Commission Chief: Differences Are Natural to a Living Party
author: Fabiola Martínez and Jessica Xantomila
content:
_This article by Fabiola Martínez and Jessica Xantomila originally appeared in
the[September 15, 2026 edition of La
Jornada](https://www.jornada.com.mx/noticia/2026/09/15/politica/citlali-
hernandez-diferencias-en-morena-son-naturales-de-un-partido-vivo), Mexico's
premier left-wing daily newspaper._

After handing over 10 of the 17 state coordinating posts of the Defense of the
Transformation and National Sovereignty, Citlalli Hernández, president of the
National Elections Commission, said that **the differences that have arisen
around this internal process are natural to a living party**.

"In that open discussion, which should frighten no one, since it is evidently
such an open process that it provokes discussion, activism, participation in
the streets, our members may have a preference for one or another, according
to their closeness, according to their track record — well, there are diverse
opinions," she asserted.

> In the end, our movement has the capacity to reach agreement and for all
> generations to coexist — from the founders to those who have joined
> recently.
>
> Citlalli Hernández

Nevertheless, she emphasized at a press conference, "we could affirm with
total conviction and certainty that so far **the 10 profiles are comrades who
back the transformation** ; they won thanks to their territorial work."

"In the end, our movement has the capacity to reach agreement and for all
generations to coexist, from the founders to those who have joined recently,"
she said.

Hernández added that **being a founder or a recent arrival is not synonymous
with being beyond reproach** , or vice versa.
